title: Auto-played secondary toast above the action menu
description: Auto mode with a prepared secondary: after it went out, the seat's own action menu opens and the "Auto-played your prepared secondary" toast is still showing. It used to sit at a fixed 16 px from the bottom, over the menu's buttons (nightly 2026-10-20, run s1-08). It now docks above the turn action bar (--bottom-bar-offset). The before shots use the old fixed offset (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before); npm run screenshots -- GO regenerates the after shots and asserts the toast's bottom edge is not below the bar's top edge.

shots.heading: Before, desktop
shots.caption: The toast lies over the Trade/Components/Action cards buttons of the action menu.

shots.heading: After, desktop
shots.caption: The toast sits above the action bar; every button is visible.

shots.heading: Before, phone 390x844
shots.caption: The toast covers the action menu.

shots.caption: The toast sits above the action bar.
